name: COVID-19 - Vaccinations by Region, Age, and Race-Ethnicity - Historical

columns.name: Population Size
columns.description: Number of people in the combination of the age and race/ethnicity group

columns.name: 1st Dose
columns.description: Number of people who have received one dose.

columns.name: 1st Dose Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have received one dose.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed
columns.description: Number of people who have a completed vaccine series.

columns.name: Vaccine Series Completed Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have a completed vaccine series.

columns.name: Bivalent
columns.description: Number of people who have received a bivalent (updated) vaccine dose.

columns.name: Bivalent Percent
columns.description: Percentage of people who have received a bivalent (updated) vaccine dose.

columns.name: Region Centroid
columns.description: A point that falls inside the Equity Zone, usually the centroid but adjusted if the centroid would fall outside the region. It is present to facilitate geographic analysis.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'region_centroid' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
